QuestInfo.name: Summer Break: Cody's BBQ - Start
QuestInfo.0: Hooray for Summer! I heard Cody's having a barbecue! I better head over and see if I can help!
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with Cody, and it looks like he needs help. I'll need to bring 10 #b#t4031664#s#k 10 #b#t4031665#s#k and 10 #b#t4031666##k to Cody so he can finish cooking. Just the sound of all that makes me hungry!
QuestInfo.2: I got all the ingredients Cody needed to start the barbecue! With the items he gave me, I can continue to enjoy the summer in style!

0.0: Hey! Nice to see you on this hot summer day. Makes me want to snag something to drink. Think you can help me out with a little barbecue?

yes.0: Enthusiasm! Always good to see. Well, I'm preparing a barbecue for some of friends and we're running low on ingredients. It starts pretty soon, so I'll need you to gather #b10 #t4031664#s (#i4031664#), 10 #t4031665#s (#i4031665#) and 10 #t4031666# (#i4031666#)#k, after that I can finish the barbecue! Thanks a bunch. I'll be waiting!

no.0: Er, Maple BBQ isn't exactly animal meat if you are in any case vegetarian, but I understand. Come back if you change your mind!

1.0: Fantastic! Everything's here. I'll be able to whip some mighty fine barbecue now! I've got some serious cooking to do. Now just give me a minute...

yes.0: Yes, I'm done cooking! This BBQ turned out to be just right! Here, take one of these BBQs I cooked with the ingredients you gave. It's still hot, so be careful with it! Oh, and this hat is a gift of my thanks to your help.

item.0: Looks like you haven't got all the ingredients yet, champ! Get going!
